title.zh: Borrow Against Your Bitcoin at a Fixed Rate: Coinbase Expands Morpho Loans
title.en: Borrow Against Your Bitcoin at a Fixed Rate: Coinbase Expands Morpho Loans

current_state.zh: Coinbase launched fixed-rate USDC loans against Bitcoin collateral powered by Morpho, the first enterprise-scale deployment of Morpho Midnight, adding to its existing Morpho-based variable-rate book of over $1.4 billion in active loans.
current_state.en: Coinbase launched fixed-rate USDC loans against Bitcoin collateral powered by Morpho, the first enterprise-scale deployment of Morpho Midnight, adding to its existing Morpho-based variable-rate book of over $1.4 billion in active loans.
